one_line: Sindhi Sufi poet-saint of Bhit Shah whose sung verses bridged mystic Islam and local folk traditions.

appearance.age_look: early 50s, slender but sturdy build, modest and dignified
appearance.face: oval face with a calm, thoughtful look; warm wheatish Sindhi complexion; straight nose; slightly arched brows; neatly trimmed medium-length beard and moustache; gentle eyes with a soft, introspective default expression
appearance.hair: deep black hair with a few subtle greying strands at the temples, parted in the middle and combed back to just below the ears; covered by a simple off-white Sindhi-style turban wrapped low and snug, with one narrow tail tucked over the left shoulder
appearance.costume: a long, straight-cut Sindhi kurta in soft matte ivory cotton reaching just below the knees, slightly loose at the sleeves; over it a sleeveless, hip-length waistcoat (sadri) of muted indigo-blue handwoven cloth with a subtle vertical stripe texture and simple dark wooden buttons; lower garment is a traditional Sindhi lehnga-style wide dhoti or skirted wrap in warm sand-beige cotton, pleated at the front and falling to the ankles; feet in plain brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest upturned toes; a light, finely-woven cotton ajrak-style shawl draped over his shoulders, predominantly deep maroon with traditional indigo and white geometric block-print patterns along the borders, one end hanging down his front and the other flowing behind; minimal jewellery limited to a small, simple silver ring on his right hand and a slender tasbih (prayer bead) loop at his waist, mostly tucked out of sight.
appearance.signature: a handcrafted tanpura-like long-necked stringed instrument made of warm brown polished wood, with a rounded gourd body, four visible tuning pegs at the top, and a simple cloth strap in maroon and indigo so it can hang across his back or be held upright when singing.

ref_desc: Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai is a wheatish-complexioned, bearded Sindhi poet-saint in an ivory kurta, indigo waistcoat, sand-beige dhoti, maroon–indigo ajrak shawl, off-white turban, brown mojari shoes, carrying a wooden tanpura-like instrument with warm brown accents.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style model sheet of Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai: a dignified Sindhi Sufi poet in his early 50s, oval wheatish face, calm introspective eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed medium-length black beard with slight greying at the temples, and deep black hair parted and combed back, covered by a simple off-white Sindhi turban wrapped low and snug with a narrow tail over his left shoulder. Show him wearing a long ivory cotton kurta just below the knees, with slightly loose sleeves, overlaid by a sleeveless hip-length indigo-blue handwoven waistcoat with subtle vertical stripe texture and plain dark wooden buttons. His lower garment is a traditional sand-beige cotton dhoti or skirted wrap with front pleats, falling to the ankles, and he has plain brown leather mojari-style shoes. Draped over his shoulders is a finely-woven ajrak-style shawl, deep maroon with indigo and white geometric block-print patterns on the borders, one end hanging in front and the other trailing behind to add gentle movement. Include a small silver ring on his right hand and a slender tasbih loop barely visible at his waist. His signature prop is a tanpura-like long-necked wooden stringed instrument with a rounded gourd body, warm brown polished surface, four tuning pegs, and a maroon-and-indigo cloth strap, shown both slung across his back and held upright in his hand in different views. Present front, back, and three-quarter views to clearly show the turban, face, beard, shawl drape, kurta, waistcoat, dhoti folds, shoes, and instrument details, using ivory, indigo, deep maroon, sand beige, and warm brown as the dominant colours.
